verdict.rationale: The evidence documents integrations such as Linear/Jira issue analysis, cross-repo linking and an MCP server. It also documents configuration via cubic.yaml and role-based access control over subscription and settings. None of it shows an admin control that allows or restricts which external tools or integrations the review agent may access. RBAC governs who changes settings, and cubic.yaml governs review behavior and ignore patterns; both are adjacent controls, not tool-access permissions.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control which external tools and integrations the agent is allowed to access
